title: ReferenceQualityProfile
description: A PINNED quality ANCHOR folded from 1-5 human-selected, market-validated reference novels (loaded from sources/reference-novels/), never a live oracle. Each reference chapter is measured with the EXACT SAME deterministic detectors the runtime runs on generated chapters (density / ai_taste / hook / length), then folded per-feature into a market-validated distribution band (median + IQR [q1,q3] + min/max + n) so a generated chapter's own measurement can later be placed against 'what a market-validated chapter looks like' WITHOUT the saturating LLM judge. COMPARISON-ONLY and never gates (ADR-003): the profile and any gap read against it are advisory, informing a human, never blocking a build. Written to registry/derived/reference/, NEVER to registry/facts/ (a reference measurement is not a story fact, ADR-006) and never the published log (ADR-009). The deterministic aggregation is pure (same corpus => same profile); the optional judge_bands arm is opt-in and only present when a reviewer/model is supplied for the double-measure.

source_ids.description: The reference-novel source ids (REF-###) folded into this profile.

chapters_measured.description: Total reference chapters (across all sources) that contributed a measurement.

bands.description: feature-key -> distribution band, for the declared comparable DETERMINISTIC features only (density.* / ai_taste.* / hook.*). Identity/size features are measured but excluded — they are not quality signals on their own.

judge_bands.description: OPT-IN double-measure: judge.<dim> -> band, present only when a reviewer/model was supplied at build time. Empty {} for the pure deterministic build.

gating.description: ADR-003: the reference anchor and any gap read against it are advisory and NEVER gate a build.

band.description: A per-feature distribution folded across measured reference chapters. median/q1/q3/min/max are null when n is 0.
